a.lede: Humanity has thrived thanks to a stable cryosphere, but burning fossil fuels has increased the risk of “accelerating and partly irreversible” harm to the planet’s cold places.
a.title: Climate Change Has Pushed the World's Ice Out of Its Safe Zone
